set -eu
umask 077
cd /home/admin1/projects/ai-core
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,time,urllib.request,os,re,sys
rev='851bf6e806efd8d0a36b00ddf55e13ccb7b8cd0a'
model='Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B'
base='https://huggingface.co/'+model
root=pathlib.Path('models/Qwen3.5-4B-hf-851bf6e8')
manifest=root.with_name(root.name+'.manifest.json')
assert not root.is_symlink() and not manifest.is_symlink()
assert shutil.disk_usage(root.parent).free>20*1024**3
root.mkdir(mode=0o700,exist_ok=True)
assert root.is_dir()
with urllib.request.urlopen('https://huggingface.co/api/models/'+model+'/revision/'+rev+'?blobs=true',timeout=12) as response:
    meta=json.loads(response.read(1024*1024))
assert meta['id']==model and meta['sha']==rev and meta['cardData']['license']=='apache-2.0'
names=['LICENSE','config.json','chat_template.jinja','tokenizer_config.json','tokenizer.json','merges.txt','vocab.json','model.safetensors.index.json','model.safetensors-00001-of-00002.safetensors','model.safetensors-00002-of-00002.safetensors']
known={'model.safetensors-00001-of-00002.safetensors':(5329398688,'26a93f066e1916adb13453dae5a0c707c0fbc71299ed98779571a907b8e74c61'),'model.safetensors-00002-of-00002.safetensors':(3990429408,'cb544bd9bfae93dc59b0f22b292f5933573854a7f9b97835c67060d7d910e188')}
files={i['rfilename']:i for i in meta['siblings'] if i['rfilename'] in names}
assert set(files)==set(names)
assert all((files[n]['size'],files[n]['lfs']['sha256'])==pair for n,pair in known.items())
def checked(path, entry):
    assert path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink() and path.stat().st_size==entry['size']
    s=hashlib.sha256()
    blob=hashlib.sha1()
    blob.update(('blob '+str(entry['size'])+'\0').encode())
    with path.open('rb') as f:
        while True:
            block=f.read(8*1024*1024)
            if not block: break
            s.update(block);blob.update(block)
    lfs=entry.get('lfs')
    if lfs:
        assert s.hexdigest()==lfs['sha256'], 'CHECKPOINT_SHA_MISMATCH'
    else:
        assert re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}',entry.get('blobId','')) and blob.hexdigest()==entry['blobId'], 'CHECKPOINT_BLOB_MISMATCH'
    return s.hexdigest()
deadline=time.monotonic()+115
verified={}
partial=[]
error=None
try:
    for name in names:
        final=root/name
        part=root/(name+'.part')
        assert not final.is_symlink() and not part.is_symlink()
        e=files[name]
        if final.exists():
            verified[name]=checked(final,e);continue
        assert not part.exists() or (part.is_file() and part.stat().st_size<=e['size'])
        if not part.exists() or part.stat().st_size<e['size']:
            remaining=int(deadline-time.monotonic())
            if remaining<=5: break
            cmd=['curl','--fail','--silent','--show-error','--location','--proto','=https','--proto-redir','=https','--connect-timeout','10','--max-time',str(remaining),'--continue-at','-','--output',str(part),base+'/resolve/'+rev+'/'+name]
            p=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,timeout=remaining+3)
            if p.returncode:
                error='DOWNLOAD_INCOMPLETE_'+str(p.returncode)
                break
        verified[name]=checked(part,e)
        os.rename(part,final)
except Exception as ex:
    error=type(ex).__name__
for n in names:
    p=root/(n+'.part')
    if p.is_file(): partial.append({'name':n,'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'total':files[n]['size']})
complete=set(verified)==set(names)
if complete:
    assert set(p.name for p in root.iterdir())==set(names)
    payload={'model':model,'revision':rev,'sha256':verified}
    temp=manifest.with_suffix('.json.part')
    assert not temp.exists() and not temp.is_symlink()
    with temp.open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f:
        json.dump(payload,f,indent=2);f.write('\n');f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
    os.replace(temp,manifest)
report={'status':'CHECKPOINT_READY' if complete else 'PARTIAL_NOT_READY','revision':rev,'verified_count':len(verified),'total_files':len(names),'verified_bytes':sum(files[n]['size'] for n in verified),'total_bytes':sum(files[n]['size'] for n in names),'verified_sha256':verified,'partial':partial,'error':error,'training_updates':0,'provider_calls':0}
body='## Official Qwen3.5-4B training checkpoint staged download\n\n```json\n'+json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n```\n\nExisting models directory; exact public revision, no replacement of serving GGUF, no external learning data or training.'
subprocess.run(['gh','issue','comment','1','--repo','seigo-gace/ai-core','--body-file','-'],input=body,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=20)
print(json.dumps({'status':report['status'],'verified_count':len(verified),'partial':partial}))
if not complete: sys.exit(2)
